_comment: DATED EVENTS THE NEWSLETTERS LOOK AHEAD TO. Edit freely — one line each.
_why_a_file: There is no free, reliable API for an economic calendar, and guessing dates is worse than having none: a newsletter that says 'CPI is Tuesday' when it is Thursday is worse than one that says nothing. So these are declared, dated, and easy to correct. Anything in the past is dropped automatically, and a stale file is reported rather than silently producing an empty week-ahead.
